crossRefs.note: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’
translations.bsb: And the LORD asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Can I really bear a child when I am old?’
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, who am old?
